decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template draws on the firm's shop hosting expertise, but it is a minor, low-visibility item that may be retired as shop platforms evolve, and it has not been observed since 2018.
The responsive template fits the firm's CMS know-how and costs little to maintain, yet it was only mentioned in passing and is easily replaced by newer templates.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so the firm can interpret customer uptake well and refine the offer.
The version management tool builds on the firm's own software development and its tools that reduce operational work for developers and agencies, which supports continued improvement.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and sits at the center of its hosting and data center know-how, making it the strategic focus to develop further.
